product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system for physiotherapy clinics that combines traditional clinical management features with Artificial Intelligence assistance to optimize patient care, clinical documentation, and operational management.
core_goals: Digitalize and automate physiotherapy clinical processes
Enhance quality of clinical documentation using AI
Increase operational efficiency and patient satisfaction
key_features: Complete patient management system with personal data, clinical history, and interactive body map
Advanced scheduling system with multiple views, conflict prevention, recurring appointments, and notifications
Comprehensive clinical documentation module with rich text editor, auto-save, version history, and customizable templates
AI Assistant for automatic report generation, treatment protocol suggestions, risk analysis, clinical consultations, and financial insights
Extensive exercise library with categories, multimedia support, personalized prescription, contraindication alerts, and difficulty levels
Patient Portal for secure access to personal records, prescribed exercises, appointment scheduling, and communication with the clinic
Dashboard and Reports providing operational metrics, financial indicators, clinical analytics, and customizable export
Financial management with payment control, delinquency tracking, and multiple payment integrations
Inventory management system with stock alerts and movement history
Task management with prioritization, progress tracking, and notifications
Teleconsultation system integrated with video calls
Automated backup and audit logging systems
Integration with external APIs and legacy systems
Performance optimizations including lazy loading and PWA support
Security features including two-factor authentication, role-based access, encryption, and LGPD compliance
user_flow_summary: User logs in via secure authentication with role-based access control
Administrator manages users, financial data, inventory, and system settings
Physiotherapists access patient records, document clinical sessions, prescribe exercises, and manage schedules
Patients use the portal to view their records, follow exercise plans, request or view appointments, and communicate with the clinic
Booking appointments using daily, weekly, or monthly calendar views with automatic conflict checking and notifications
Clinicians use AI Assistant to generate reports, receive treatment suggestions, and consult clinical queries
Clinic generates and exports detailed reports and analytics from dashboard
Manage financial transactions and monitor payment statuses
Healthcare staff mark body pain points on interactive body map and track evolution
validation_criteria: System supports multi-role authentication and session management with timeout
Patient data validation includes unique CPF and secure photo/document uploads
Scheduling prevents conflicts, allows recurring events, and sends notifications reliably
Rich text clinical documentation auto-saves and maintains version history
AI assistant generates accurate reports with over 95% precision and suggests treatment protocols
Exercise prescriptions respect contraindications and reflect personalized plans
Patient portal provides secure access with data privacy adherence and communication capabilities
Reports export correctly in PDF and data is visually accurate
Financial system processes payments including PIX and generates financial metrics reliably
System uptime meets 99.5% availability and handles 100 concurrent users
Backup runs automatically daily and audit logs are comprehensive and secure
System is responsive across devices and maintains a load time under 2 seconds
